_identifyingAttributesComment: Direct patient/operator identifiers a de-identification profile is expected to remove or empty; presence with a value in a forwarded instance is flagged as a residual privacy risk. NOTE: this check is NOT performed by the dciodvfy verifier — the tag set mirrors the attributes deleted by dciodvfy's companion de-identifier dcanon (appsrc/dcfile/dcanon.script -d entries). Lowercase 8-digit hex tags.
_unpairedBodyPartsComment: Body Part Examined (0018,0015) Defined Terms that denote an unpaired (midline) structure; any body part NOT in this list is treated as paired and is expected to carry a Laterality. Verbatim from dciodvfy's LateralityRequired condition (libsrc/standard/condn.tpl). Uppercase.
_zeroComment: Numeric attributes whose value must not be zero. zeroIsError = structural counts / geometry where zero is illegal (dciodvfy NotZeroError); zeroIsWarning = acquisition / physics parameters where zero is implausible (dciodvfy NotZeroWarning). Lowercase 8-digit hex tags.
_functionalGroupMacrosComment: Top-level sequence (and its Type within the macro) carried by each Functional Group Macro, keyed by the macroId of ciod_to_func_group_macros.json. Derived from innolitics macro_to_attributes.json (top-level SQ attributes). The vendored module_to_attributes.json flattens each macro under both the Shared (5200,9229) and the Per-frame (5200,9230) Functional Groups Sequences; the validator uses this map with the macro usage instead.
_perFrameOnlyFunctionalGroupMacrosCommen: Functional Group Macros that may only be part of the Per-frame Functional Groups Sequence (PS3.3 C.7.6.16.2.2 Frame Content), whatever their conditional statement says. Macros whose conditional statement says they shall/may not be used as a Shared Functional Group are detected automatically.
_functionalGroupConditionsComment: Machine-evaluable usage conditions of Functional Group Macros with usage C, keyed by ciodId/macroId and evaluated on the top-level dataset. A C macro without an entry (condition on frame content, other macros or free text) is only validated when present. valueIndex (1-based) restricts the comparison to one value of a multi-valued attribute.
